title: 第2章 梦境恶魔弗莱迪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这奇怪的内容搞得李艾一头雾水，他只觉得这是一封恶作剧信件。

因为总会有不着调的人制作这种东西戏耍邻居，有些时候还会夹杂血腥图片和恶毒诅咒。

相比起来，一串莫名其妙的文字已经显得很温和了。

随手一折信纸，将其丢入垃圾桶后，他便前往南希的家。

此时已是深秋时节，夜晚的微风已经出现一点凉意，李艾裹紧身上的夹克，步行了十几分钟后，他来到南希家门前。

一道清脆的铃声过后，门后传来了沉重的脚步声，一位中年白人男性

“原来是你啊。”男人点了点头，随后露出了放心的笑容，“进来吧，南希在书房等你好久了。”

“多谢，汤普森警长。”李艾朝还没有脱下警服的男人说道，随后在对方的注视下进入屋内，他在二楼书房内找到了南希。

“你终于来了！”南希面露喜意，快步走到李艾身边，然后压低声音问道，“我爸没有为难你吧？”

“放心，警长对好市民还是有些优待的。”李艾笑着说道。

“那就好。”南希如释重负地点了点头，随后拉着李艾来到书桌前，说道：“接下来就麻烦你了，好学生。”

“小问题，你听好了……”

过了一段时间后，南希的母亲带着一盘蛋糕来到书房。

“累了就吃点蛋糕吧，知道你们两个最近睡眠都不好，就放了有助于睡眠的樱桃。”

“谢谢阿姨。”李艾随口谢道，不过并没有准备多吃，这些白人零食都齁甜，不符合他的口味。

李艾也只吃了几颗樱桃，就连南希也没有吃太多。

南希捏了捏自己的肚子，调笑道：“我还是很注意身材的，蛋糕吃多了会变胖的。”

“你这是提前为毕业典礼做准备？”李艾侧目道。

“是啊，我看上了一条特别好看的裙子。”

说话间，一股困意袭来，二人本来就数天没有休息好，这一下更是觉得要以头抢地。

“我先回家了。”李艾连忙起身，要是在南希家睡去，汤普森警长可就要看他不爽了。

“祝你有个好梦，李艾。”

“晚安，南希。”

互道晚安之后，他就离开了书房，汤普森警长见自己女儿这同学如此讲究分寸，就主动开车送李艾回家，帮他节省了一点时间。

李艾回到了自己的家中，他将房门锁紧，然后回到自己的房间，直接躺在柔软的大床上，并给自己定了一个闹钟。

随后，一股强烈的困意袭来，李艾的眼皮不断打颤，没多久就沉沉睡去了。

意识逐渐变得昏沉，不知过了多久后，他耳边传来一连串刺耳的金属摩擦声。

呲啦——

李艾再次睁开眼睛，却发觉自己身处在一间老旧工厂内，机器不断运转，发出淡淡的火光，他走在哐当作响的格栅走道上，不断向深处走去。

金属摩擦声变得愈发刺耳，他开始在工厂内奔跑，但那声音如影随形，不断追逐着他。

李艾发现一扇大门，直接毫不犹豫地推门而入，然后将房门锁紧，这才短暂摆脱了那刺耳的声音。

他紧张地打量四周，发现这是一间没有任何出路的房间，并在墙壁上发现两道影子。

一道高大，一道纤细，两者不断纠缠，最后，高大的影子举起长着利爪的手，将那道纤细的影子撕得粉碎。

这一幕看得李艾不敢喘气。

在将纤细的影子撕碎后，高大的影子脱离墙面，在房间中凝聚出人形，朝着李艾举起利爪。

李艾急忙一躲，但那利爪也撕裂了他的肩膀，在他的肩膀上留下四道血痕，鲜血不断流出。

黑影突兀地消失，随之而来一阵张狂的笑声。

“哈哈哈哈！！！！！”

李艾只能捂住双耳，试图挡住这刺耳的笑声。

叮铃铃————

This strange content confused Li Ai. He only thought it was a prank letter.

Because there will always be unscrupulous people making such things to tease their neighbors, and sometimes they will be mixed with bloody pictures and vicious curses.

In comparison, a string of inexplicable words already seemed very mild.

After casually folding the letter and throwing it into the trash can, he headed to Nancy's house.

It was already late autumn, and the night breeze was already a little chilly. Li Ai wrapped his jacket tightly and walked for more than ten minutes before he arrived in front of Nancy's house.

After a crisp ringing, heavy footsteps came from behind the door. A middle-aged white man

"So it's you." The man nodded, then showed a relieved smile, "Come in, Nancy has been waiting for you in the study for a long time."

"Thank you, Chief Thompson." Li Ai said to the man who had not yet taken off his police uniform, and then entered the house under the gaze of the other man. He found Nancy in the study on the second floor.

"You're finally here!" Nancy looked happy, walked quickly to Li Ai, and then lowered her voice and asked, "My dad didn't make things difficult for you, right?"

"Don't worry, the Sheriff still gives some preferential treatment to good citizens." Li Ai said with a smile.

"That's good." Nancy nodded with relief, then pulled Li Ai to the desk and said, "I'll trouble you next, good student."

"Small question, listen carefully..."

After some time, Nancy's mother came to the study with a plate of cakes.

"Eat some cake when you're tired. I know you two haven't been sleeping well lately, so I put some cherries to help you sleep."

"Thank you, Auntie." Li Ai thanked casually, but he was not prepared to eat more. These white snacks were too sweet and did not suit his taste.

Li Ai only ate a few cherries, and even Nancy didn't eat too many.

Nancy pinched her belly and said teasingly: "I still pay attention to my figure. If you eat too much cake, you will get fat."

"Are you preparing for the graduation ceremony in advance?" Li Ai asked sideways.

"Yes, I have my eye on a particularly beautiful skirt."

While talking, a feeling of sleepiness came over them. The two of them had not had a good rest for several days, and now they felt like they were fighting for the ground.

"I'm going home first." Li Ai stood up quickly. If he fell asleep at Nancy's house, Chief Thompson would be unhappy with him.

"I wish you a good dream, Li Ai."

"Good night, Nancy."

After saying good night to each other, he left the study. Seeing that his daughter's classmate was so particular about propriety, Sheriff Thompson took the initiative to drive Li Ai home, saving him some time.

Li Ai returned to his home. He locked the door, then returned to his room, lay down directly on the soft bed, and set an alarm clock for himself.

Then, a strong feeling of sleepiness came over him. Li Ai's eyelids kept trembling, and he fell into a deep sleep soon.

His consciousness gradually became drowsy, and after an unknown amount of time, a series of harsh metal friction sounds came from his ears.

Bah--

Li Ai opened his eyes again, only to find that he was in an old factory. The machines were constantly running and emitting a faint light of fire. He walked on the creaking grille walkway and kept walking deeper.

The sound of metal friction became more and more harsh, and he began to run through the factory, but the sound followed him like a shadow, constantly chasing him.

Li Ai found a door and pushed it in without hesitation, then locked the door tightly and was briefly freed from the harsh sound.

He looked around nervously and found that it was a room with no way out, and found two shadows on the wall.

One was tall and the other was slender. The two were constantly entangled. Finally, the tall shadow raised its clawed hands and tore the slender shadow into pieces.

Li Ai didn't dare to breathe after seeing this scene.

After tearing the slender shadow into pieces, the tall shadow broke away from the wall, condensed into a human shape in the room, and raised its sharp claws towards Li Ai.

Li Ai hurriedly hid, but the sharp claw also tore his shoulder, leaving four blood marks on his shoulder, and blood continued to flow out.

The black shadow suddenly disappeared, followed by a burst of wild laughter.

"Hahahahaha!!!!!!"

Li Ai could only cover his ears, trying to block the harsh laughter.
